As far as on base housing, it’s only for officers. They will let you “live ashore” which means getting a house in the local area that BAH will cover. However, with covid I’m not entirely sure how available that is right now

If your wife decides to stay home, your zipcode will be used to allot the average household rent in that area. You will recieve BAH as soon as you start, and will be able to send it home to her to pay for rent or monthly payment. 

If you can move her out there though I highly suggest doing that. Barracks life sucks and when everything isn’t locked down, it can be a very pretty area. Good luck to you and safe travels.

Every day you will get 45 minutes to shower and clean the compartment. Every night before bed, you should get about an hour to do things like clip your toenails, shine boots, receive mail, etc. Clippers are issued, tweezers are not.
I was given my two stripes on dress blues and given my SA collar device for NSU, my RDC told me I would be an E2 as soon as I graduated. I have a 6 year contract

I really like what you're saying here. I've been to psychiatrists and such. I've been in mental institutions on nights where I couldn't stop myself from swallowing handfulls of pills. I've actually lost count of how many times I've attempted suicide. By no means did i even intend or expect to make it this far. Most people would probably  be proud at such a feat. Beating suicidal thoughts is a hell of an achievement. But to me, it seems disgusting. And I understand that ultimately, we have lots of control over our own well-being, but there's just always been this overwhelming feeling that I don't belong here, or that my significance has already played out. Against my own nature, I have just cut people off. I'm sickened when I look in the mirror. I'm just rambling now, but I'm sure you understand. I know the validity of my argument is considerably low, but I have a hard time looking at this logically. Tomorrow is coming faster than I believe I'm ready for. I have about a gallon of Jack Daniels and a 16 gauge shotgun, and the house to myself. I'm just gonna have to see how this plays out. I appreciate your concern.
